title: World road graph (public/tiles/<world>/roads.json). Produced by the pipeline, consumed by sim traffic/robots and GPS routing.
$comment: The file, its nodes and its edges are closed: an undeclared key fails the schema suite. Declare a new field here before shipping it; a key starting with x- is free for experiments and is never a contract.

attribution.description: Source credit for the street data

y.description: Ground height at the node, metres

oneway.description: true = traffic flows a -> b only

points.description: Polyline [x, z] in local metres, first = node a, last = node b

cnn.description: Source tracing: the DataSF street segment's CNN

classcode.description: Source tracing: the DataSF street class code (0 other, 1 freeway, 2 highway, 3 arterial, 4 collector, 5 residential, 6 ramp); null when absent

pedestrian.description: Pedestrian-only street: not for vehicles. Absent = open to traffic

gradeSeparated.description: Limited-access road crossing other streets on a viaduct, in a cut or in a tunnel. The points and node y are the ground under it, not the deck: surface traffic must not be routed onto it. Absent = at grade

bridge.description: Part of the edge crosses open water on a deck the source gives no height for; y there is sea level. Absent = no water crossing
